item.description:
Release v5.8.2

Changes since v5.8.1

  • feat(ConversationLanguagePlugin): refactor to match ConversationVerbosityPlugin structure
  • feat(RClickPlugin): add default menu items and cached URL support
  • feat(WorkspacePlugin): persist per-container split layout
  • fix: update Finder visibility actions and panel layout
  • fix(AppSplitDivider): refresh tracking area after restoring divider position
  • fix(BookletMakerPlugin): add missing localization keys for mode/sheet labels
  • fix(BookletMakerPlugin): localize page count label in drop zone
  • fix(GoalTaskPlugin): improve localization to match project standard
  • fix(GoalTaskPlugin): localize toolbar strings and plugin description
  • fix(layout): restore live split resizing behavior
  • fix(LumiFinder): fix concurrency issue in FinderSync action
  • fix(message-list): avoid freezing empty conversation state
  • fix(RClickPlugin): embed Finder Sync extension and guard actions
  • fix(split): defer kernel sync during drag, restore initial divider positions
  • perf(MessageListPlugin): use CALayer for live-resize frozen frame
  • refactor(BookletMakerPlugin): restructure BookletExplanationView layout
